                         SAFETY NOTICE

      Voltages used in this equipment are high enough to endanger human life
and may be fatal if contacted by operating personnel. Operators must be
careful not to contact the power supply while checking or servicing the equip-
ment. Be sure that the power is off before touching terminals and conductors
with bare hands. A\l test leads should be insulated.
